guide.intro: Everything you need to run your first service, in order. Steps tick themselves off as you go.

screens.title: Connect your screens
screens.body: Open Outputs and set your projector or TV to Main output. Only have a laptop? Turn on Rehearsal / window mode to see the output in a small window.

packages.title: Add Bibles and hymnals
packages.body: The King James Version is included. Install other Bible versions (.lsbible) and hymnals (.lshymnal) from files you have been given.

service.title: Build your service
service.body: Pick songs from the Library on the left, verses in the Bible workspace, and media from the bin at the bottom. Double-click (or drag) to put them in the service plan. Drag items to reorder, and use Section to group them.

live.title: Click to go live
live.body: Click a slide and it's on the screen (red). Use {{previous}} / {{next}} to step through slides. Prefer a safety step? Turn on Preview first in the toolbar: clicks go to Preview (green) and {{goLive}} sends them.

control.title: Stay in control
control.body: {{clearContent}} clears the text but keeps the background; {{black}} blacks out the screen; {{panic}} is the panic button that clears everything except the background.

backup.title: Keep your library safe
backup.body: Lampstand backs up daily on its own. Use Export to move your songs, services and media to another computer.

guide.quickBarHelp: Press {{key}} and type a verse, a hymn number or words from a song. Enter shows it (or previews it with Preview first on); Shift+Enter always shows it now.
guide.keysHelp: Change any of them under More › Keyboard shortcuts in the toolbar.

preview.title: Green
preview.body: Preview — ready, not on screen yet.

live.title: Red
live.body: Live — this is on the screen right now.

accent.title: Gold
accent.body: Selected or editable — never affects the screen.

tour.title: Find your way around
tour.help: The window reads left to right: what you have, what you show, what the room sees.

toolbar.title: Toolbar
toolbar.body: Search (or {{quick}}) finds songs, verses and hymns. Show, Edit, Reflow and Bible switch the workspace; Theme opens Themes, and Stage is under More. On the right: the media bin, the Audience and Stage screen lights (green means connected), Preview first, Settings and Status.

sidebar.title: Library and playlists
sidebar.body: The outline at the top lists your libraries (Songs, Hymns) and playlists. Pick one to see its contents underneath: songs to drag in, or the playlist’s items with coloured section bands. Use + to add a song, a playlist or an item.

show.title: Show (the centre)
show.body: The whole playlist on one page, item after item. Click a slide to put it on screen (or into Preview with Preview first on); double-click always goes live; right-click edits it. Switch Grid / Easy (big words) and the slide size at the bottom right.

output.title: Output
output.body: The monitor shows exactly what the room sees. The strip beside it clears one layer at a time (messages, props, slide, media, background); the red power button turns everything off. Below: the Audience or Stage view, and Black (B), Logo (L) and Freeze (F).

controls.title: Show controls
controls.body: Under the monitor: the stage message, timers, messages with fill-in fields, and props. Anything you start here shows on the screens straight away.

media.title: Media bin
media.body: Open it with Media in the toolbar: pictures and videos you import, and the built-in still and motion backgrounds. Click to show, double-click to add to the playlist, or drag onto the slides.

howto.title: How to…
howto.help: Short recipes for the everyday jobs. Click one to open it.

song.a: Click + next to LIBRARY. Type the words with section headers like [Verse 1] and [Chorus] on their own lines; a blank line starts a new slide. Save, then drag the song onto the playlist, or use its Add to service button.

playlist.a: Click + next to PLAYLISTS. Add sections (Walk-in, Worship, Word…) and items from the + above the items, or drag songs, verses and media in. Drag to reorder; a section moves with everything under it.

verse.q: Put a Bible verse on screen
verse.a: Press {{quick}} and type a reference such as jn 3 16 or Romans 8:28-39. Enter loads Preview, Shift+Enter puts it straight on screen. The Bible workspace lets you browse and pick verse ranges.

preview.q: Check slides before the room sees them
preview.a: Turn on Preview first in the toolbar. Clicks then load the Preview monitor; press {{goLive}} (or Go live) to send it to the screens.

clear.a: Use the strip beside the monitor to clear one layer, or the red power button ({{clearAll}}) to clear everything. {{panic}} clears the words but keeps the background. Black and Logo cover the screen without losing your place.

backgrounds.a: Open the media bin and pick Backgrounds. Hover a motion background to see it move, click to put it behind your words. Themes can carry a background too.

arrangement.q: Change a song’s order, key or language
arrangement.a: In a song’s header on the Show page, pick an arrangement (a short version, say), transpose the chords for the stage display, or add a translation shown under each line. Write arrangements and translations in the song editor.

edit.a: Add Slides from the + menu, then open the Edit workspace: type a title and text, and add text boxes, shapes, lines and pictures on the canvas. Drag to move, pull the corners to resize.

import.a: Choose Import in the + menu. PowerPoint comes in as editable text slides; PDF brings each page in as a picture. From Keynote, export to PowerPoint or PDF first.

web.a: Choose Web page in the + menu and enter a secure (https) address. It shows on the audience screens in an isolated view; Black screen covers it.

props.q: Show a logo or notice over everything
props.a: In Show controls › Props, make a prop from a picture or a line of text and click it to show or hide it. Messages show text such as “Parent of {number}” as a lower third or a ticker.

timers.a: Add a Countdown item for a full-screen countdown, or start a timer in Show controls › Timers; running timers show on the stage display.

stage.a: Give a screen the Stage role in Screens (click the Audience or Stage light in the toolbar). It shows the current and next slide, the clock, timers, chords and your stage message.

themes.a: Theme in the toolbar opens Themes. Duplicate a built-in theme to change fonts, colours, effects (shadow, glow, outline) and the background, and choose which theme each kind of slide uses.

text.q: Change one song’s font or colour
text.a: Select the item in the playlist and press Text in the toolbar. Pick a font, size, bold or italic, colour and alignment; only that item changes, on top of its theme. Use theme puts it back.

logo.q: Set the logo and off-air screen
logo.a: Settings › Presenting: your church name and a tagline on a choice of looks, or your own picture or video. The off-air screen shows it whenever nothing is live.

backup.q: Back up or move your library
backup.a: Settings › Library & backups exports everything (songs, playlists, themes, media) to one file and imports it on another computer. A backup is also made every day.

undo.a: Press {{undo}} (or Edit › Undo in the menu bar) to undo changes to playlists, songs and slides; {{redo}} redoes them.

everything.title: Everything Lampstand does
everything.help: Every feature that works today, by area. Planned ones are listed in Settings › Features.

clearGroups.title: Clear groups
clearGroups.help: Each group is one button in the “…” menu beside the monitor that clears exactly the layers you tick. Anything it clears can be brought back from its layer button.
clearGroups.name: Group name

masks.title: Masks
masks.help: A mask shapes an output: bring the edges in, round the corners, use an oval, or use a picture (white shows, black hides). Everything outside the shape is black. The stage display is never masked.
masks.noOutputs: No screens are connected yet; the Program monitor shows the audience mask.

roleHelp.main: Projectors and TVs the room sees. The Program monitor shows this shape too.

masks.name: Mask name
masks.imageHelp: White areas of the picture show, black areas hide. Grey fades in between.

looks.title: Looks
looks.help: A Look decides which layers each kind of screen shows, e.g. “Lobby”: secondary screens show only the background. Switch Looks from the toolbar; the change is instant.
looks.name: Look name
